'''2011 German National Championship Horst Knepper LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Horst Knepper]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Really Grinds My Gears
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
